method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Juries Act 1957 (WA), the compilation published on legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 48914, retrieved 7 September 2026; no compilation number given), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48914.txt; no regulations used (no regulations under s 62 are deposited, so the s 58B allowances, expenses, fees and prescribed classes are inputs)

scope: From the seat of the person summonsed for jury service, for the WA cradle-to-grave lives: ss 4 (with Electoral Act 1907 ss 17AA, 17A, 17B as facts), 5 and Schedule 1 (as data), 31, 32D(2), 32E, 32I, 33(5), 33A and Schedule 2, 34E, 34F, 34G, 34H, 34I, 34J, 42, 55, 56, 56A, 56B, 56E, 58B. The officer's or court's satisfaction, reasonable excuse, undue hardship, and the Regulations' amounts and classes are inputs. Jury districts, lists and the jurors' book, choosing panels and pools, empanelling, challenges, verdicts, s 57 and the Jury Exemption Act 1965 (Cth) are out.
seat: the person summonsed for jury service

roles: I am liable for jury service, or have been summonsed for it
I employ someone who has been summonsed for jury service

situation_parameters.name: I have been served with a jury summons
situation_parameters.description: Whether a jury summons has been served on you (the questions about answering it, being excused, attending and not obeying arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I am liable for jury service, or have been summonsed for it
questions: Which items of Schedule 2 must I disclose when I answer my summons
Must I be excused from my summons on a ground of s 34G
Can my employer excuse me from my summons
Can I take my application to be excused to a judge
Do I have a good reason to be excused from my summons
What can I get by applying to be excused for good reason
Must I be excused from a trial because I would not be indifferent
Can I be excused because I served on a jury in the last 5 years
Was my jury summons served on me in time
Must I attend as my jury summons says
Can I be required to attend on this day of my jury service
Do I commit an offence if I do not obey my jury summons
What is the most I can be fined for not obeying my jury summons

situation_parameters.name: I work for an employer
situation_parameters.description: Whether you work for someone, as an employee or under a contract for services (s 56(1))
situation_parameters.role: I am liable for jury service, or have been summonsed for it
questions: Is what my employer did prejudicial action against me
Does my employer commit an offence by what it did to me
What earnings must my employer keep paying me while I do jury service
What is the most my employer can be fined for acting prejudicially against me

situation_parameters.name: my employer has been convicted under s 56(5)
situation_parameters.description: Whether a court has convicted your employer of acting prejudicially against you over jury service (s 56(5))
situation_parameters.role: I am liable for jury service, or have been summonsed for it
questions: What is the most compensation a court can order my employer to pay me
Can the court order my employer to take me back

situation_parameters.name: I have attended to serve, or served, as a juror
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have attended a court to serve, or served, as a juror under the Act (the questions about payment and about what you may say arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I am liable for jury service, or have been summonsed for it
questions: Who does the State pay my jury service fees to
How much does the State pay me for my jury service
Is it an offence for me to tell this about my jury
What is the most I can be fined for disclosing protected jury information

situation_parameters.name: I have been convicted under s 56(5)
situation_parameters.description: Whether a court has convicted you of acting prejudicially against your employee over jury service (s 56(5))
situation_parameters.role: I employ someone who has been summonsed for jury service
questions: What is the most compensation a court can order me to pay my employee
Can the court order me to take my employee back
